// =============================================================================

// T3 - webm-on-target. Parametric via a CFG object.

// Plays a JB2A/boss-loot webm centered on the target (or the caster's point for

// on-death effects), with optional white-silhouette pre-flash of the target and

// fade in/out. doneHook fires at cfg.doneAtMs after the webm starts.

// cfg.anchor: "target" | "caster"

// cfg.url: webm path

// cfg.sizeFrac: sprite width as a fraction of screen height

// cfg.preTintWhite / cfg.preTintMs: flash the target white first

// cfg.fadeInMs / cfg.fadeOutMs / cfg.doneAtMs / cfg.maxMs

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {"name":"Enkindle","key":"dryad_enkindle","url":"modules/boss-loot-assets-free/artwork/05-spell/homebrew/cast/Spell_Cast_2_Fire_1_ORANGE_1200x1200.webm","anchor":"target","fadeInMs":0,"fadeOutMs":260,"sizeFrac":0.55,"doneAtMs":360,"maxMs":1900,"endPadMs":100,"totalTimeoutMs":9000,"sfx":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitFire.ogg","sfxVol":0.6};

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][WebmTgt][" + CFG.name + "]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.webmtgt." + CFG.key;

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function meshOf(tok) { return tok ? tok.mesh : null; }

function makeSprite(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(m?.texture ?? PIXI.Texture.WHITE);

sp.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

sp.width = Math.abs(m?.width ?? (tok?.w ?? 100));

sp.height = Math.abs(m?.height ?? (tok?.h ?? 100));

sp.angle = m?.angle ?? 0;

return sp;

}

function makeHider(tok) {

const m = meshOf(tok); let on = false, tR = true, mR = true;

const guard = () => { if (!tok) return; tok.renderable = false; if (m) m.renderable = false; };

return {

start() { if (!tok || on) return; on = true; tR = tok.renderable ?? true; mR = m?.renderable ?? true; ticker.add(guard); },

restore() { if (!tok || !on) return; ticker.remove(guard); tok.renderable = tR; if (m) m.renderable = mR; try { tok.renderFlags.set({ refreshVisibility: true, refreshMesh: true, refreshState: true }); } catch (_) {} on = false; },

};

}

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = !!cfg.loop; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("loadeddata",go,{once:true}); vid.addEventListener("error",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go,1500); });

return vid;

}

try {

const anchorTok = (cfg.anchor === "caster") ? caster : (targetTokens[0] || caster);

const pt = anchorTok ? { x: anchorTok.center.x, y: anchorTok.center.y }

: { x: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.6*W,0.5*H)).x, y: WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(0.6*W,0.5*H)).y };

// optional white-silhouette pre-flash of the target

let tgtHide = null, whiteFx = null, maskSpr = null;

if (cfg.preTintWhite && anchorTok) {

tgtHide = makeHider(anchorTok); tgtHide.start();

maskSpr = makeSprite(anchorTok); maskSpr.x = pt.x; maskSpr.y = pt.y; maskSpr.zIndex = 8600;

stage.addChild(maskSpr); spawned.push(maskSpr);

const bw = Math.abs(meshOf(anchorTok)?.width ?? anchorTok.w) * 1.1;

const bh = Math.abs(meshOf(anchorTok)?.height ?? anchorTok.h) * 1.1;

whiteFx = new PIXI.Graphics();

whiteFx.beginFill(0xffffff, 1).drawRect(pt.x - bw/2, pt.y - bh/2, bw, bh).endFill();

whiteFx.mask = maskSpr; whiteFx.zIndex = 8601; whiteFx.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(whiteFx); spawned.push(whiteFx);

await tween((p) => { whiteFx.alpha = p; }, cfg.preTintMs || 200, easeOutCubic);

}

// the webm

const vid = await loadVideo(cfg.url);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nativeW = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 400;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

spr.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);

spr.x = pt.x; spr.y = pt.y; spr.zIndex = 9000;

spr.scale.set(hPx(cfg.sizeFrac) / nativeW);

spr.blendMode = (cfg.blendAdd ? PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD : PIXI.BLEND_MODES.NORMAL);

spr.alpha = cfg.fadeInMs > 0 ? 0 : 1;

stage.addChild(spr); spawned.push(spr);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

if (cfg.sfx) { try { const au = new Audio(cfg.sfx); au.volume = (cfg.sfxVol == null ? 0.6 : cfg.sfxVol); au.play().catch(()=>{}); } catch (_) {} }

if (cfg.fadeInMs > 0) tween((p) => { spr.alpha = p; }, cfg.fadeInMs, easeOutCubic);

// fire damage gate partway through

await waitMs(cfg.doneAtMs || 300);

fireDone({ ok: true });

// hold until webm ends (or maxMs), then fade + restore

const remain = Math.max(0, (cfg.maxMs || 1600) - (cfg.doneAtMs || 300));

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; if(!cfg.loop) vid.addEventListener("ended",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go, remain); });

await tween((p) => { spr.alpha = (spr.alpha) * (1 - p); if (whiteFx) whiteFx.alpha = whiteFx.alpha * (1 - p); }, cfg.fadeOutMs || 240, easeOutCubic);

destroyObj(spr);

try { vid.pause(); vid.removeAttribute("src"); vid.load(); } catch (_) {}

if (tgtHide) tgtHide.restore();

await waitMs(cfg.endPadMs || 100);

cleanupAll();

} catch (err) {

console.error("[ONI][Pseudo][WebmTgt]", err);

fireDone({ ok: false, error: String(err && err.message || err) });

} finally {

cleanupAll();

}

`;

try {

emitLocal("oni:animationStart", { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 10000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

meta: { source: CFG.name },

});

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, "pseudo non-OK / timeout", result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, "orchestration crashed", err);

} finally {

emitLocal("oni:animationEnd", { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now() });

}

})();

// =============================================================================

// Ignis Finis (bespoke, shared Dryad + Marigold). Parametric via a CFG object.

// Dim the scene -> fire particles gather at the target -> orange shimmer pulse

// -> CastFire01 webm plays large at the target with a screenshake. doneHook

// fires when the webm's flame peaks; then the dim fades out.

// =============================================================================

(async () => {

const CFG = {"fireColor":16742944,"dimAlpha":0.55,"dimMs":400,"undimMs":500,"gatherRadius":0.22,"gatherCount":26,"gatherSize":0.03,"gatherMs":620,"gatherStagger":6,"shimmerAlpha":0.22,"shimmerMs":700,"castSize":1.55,"castMaxMs":2400,"doneAtMs":500,"shakeMs":620,"shakePx":10,"fadeMs":340,"totalTimeoutMs":14000,"name":"Ignis Finis","sfxCast":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Scorch.ogg","sfxCastVol":0.6,"sfxExplosion":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Amalthea_Explosion.ogg","sfxExplosionVol":0.6,"key":"dryad_ignisfinis"};

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][IgnisFinis][" + CFG.name + "]";

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.gen.ignisfinis." + CFG.key;

const CAST_URL = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Cast/CastFire01_01_Regular_Orange_600x600.webm";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = "oni.anim." + ANIM_KEY + "." + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

function onceHook(name, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(name, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(name, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(name, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(name, data) { try { Hooks.callAll(name, data); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targetTokens = ctx.targetTokens || [];

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg;

const A = ctx.params.assets;

const stage = canvas.stage;

stage.sortableChildren = true;

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;

const WT = stage.worldTransform.clone();

const ZOOM = Math.abs(stage.scale?.x || 1) || 1;

const S2W = (fx, fy) => WT.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(fx * W, fy * H));

const wLen = (px) => px / ZOOM;

const hPx = (frac) => wLen(frac * H);

const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Number(ms) || 0));

const spawned = [];

function destroyObj(o) { try { if (o && !o._destroyed) { if (o.parent) o.parent.removeChild(o); o.destroy({ children: true }); } } catch (_) {} }

function cleanupAll() { for (const o of spawned.splice(0)) destroyObj(o); }

let doneFired = false;

function fireDone(res) { if (doneFired) return; doneFired = true; try { Hooks.callAll(ctx.params.doneHook, res || { ok: true }); } catch (_) {} }

const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

const easeInCubic = (t) => t * t * t;

function tween(fn, dur, ease) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const t0 = performance.now();

const step = () => { const raw = dur>0?Math.min(1,(performance.now()-t0)/dur):1; try{fn(ease?ease(raw):raw,raw);}catch(_){} if(raw>=1){ticker.remove(step);resolve();} };

ticker.add(step);

});

}

function dotTexture(hex) {

const s = 64; const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = s;

const g = cv.getContext("2d");

const col = "#" + (hex >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(6, "0").slice(-6);

const grd = g.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2);

grd.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); grd.addColorStop(0.4, col); grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");

g.fillStyle = grd; g.beginPath(); g.arc(s/2, s/2, s/2, 0, Math.PI*2); g.fill();

return PIXI.Texture.from(cv);

}

function fullRect(color, alpha, z, blend) {

const a = S2W(-0.1,-0.1), b = S2W(1.1,1.1);

const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

g.beginFill(color, 1).drawRect(a.x, a.y, b.x-a.x, b.y-a.y).endFill();

g.alpha = alpha; g.zIndex = z; if (blend) g.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

return g;

}

function screenShake(ms, px) {

try {

const view = canvas.app.view;

if (!document.getElementById("oni-shake-kf")) {

const st = document.createElement("style"); st.id = "oni-shake-kf";

st.textContent = "@keyframes oniShake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}15%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px," + px + "px)}30%{transform:translate(" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}45%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,-" + px + "px)}60%{transform:translate(" + px + "px," + px + "px)}75%{transform:translate(-" + px + "px,0)}} .oni-shaking{animation:oniShake 0.42s linear}";

async function loadVideo(url) {

const vid = document.createElement("video");

try { vid.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; } catch (_) {}

vid.src = url; vid.muted = true; vid.loop = false; vid.playsInline = true; vid.preload = "auto";

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("loadeddata",go,{once:true}); vid.addEventListener("error",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go,1500); });

}

function playSfx(url, vol) {

if (!url) return;

try { const a = new Audio(url); a.volume = (vol == null ? 0.6 : vol); a.play().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}

}

try {

const who = targetTokens[0] || caster;

const pt = who ? { x: who.center.x, y: who.center.y } : { x: S2W(0.6,0.5).x, y: S2W(0.6,0.5).y };

const dotTex = dotTexture(cfg.fireColor);

// 1) dim the scene

playSfx(cfg.sfxCast, cfg.sfxCastVol); // initial cast

const dim = fullRect(0x000000, 0, 7000, false);

stage.addChild(dim); spawned.push(dim);

await tween((p) => { dim.alpha = cfg.dimAlpha * p; }, cfg.dimMs, easeOutCubic);

// 2) fire particles gather at the target

const gatherR = hPx(cfg.gatherRadius);

const gathers = [];

for (let i = 0; i < cfg.gatherCount; i++) {

const ang = Math.random()*Math.PI*2, r = gatherR*(0.7+Math.random()*0.5);

const sp = new PIXI.Sprite(dotTex);

sp.anchor.set(0.5); sp.zIndex = 7200; sp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; sp.tint = cfg.fireColor;

const sz = hPx(cfg.gatherSize)*(0.6+Math.random()*0.8); sp.width = sp.height = sz;

sp.x = pt.x + Math.cos(ang)*r; sp.y = pt.y + Math.sin(ang)*r; sp.alpha = 0;

stage.addChild(sp); spawned.push(sp); gathers.push({ sp, ox: sp.x, oy: sp.y });

}

const gatherAnim = Promise.all(gathers.map(({sp,ox,oy},i) => (async () => {

await waitMs(i * (cfg.gatherStagger||6));

await tween((p) => { sp.x = ox + (pt.x-ox)*p; sp.y = oy + (pt.y-oy)*p; sp.alpha = Math.sin(p*Math.PI); sp.scale.set(1 - 0.3*p); }, cfg.gatherMs, easeInCubic);

destroyObj(sp);

})()));

// 3) orange shimmer pulse over the scene

const shim = fullRect(cfg.fireColor, 0, 7100, true);

stage.addChild(shim); spawned.push(shim);

tween((p) => { shim.alpha = Math.sin(p*Math.PI) * cfg.shimmerAlpha; }, cfg.shimmerMs, null).then(() => destroyObj(shim));

await Promise.race([gatherAnim, waitMs(cfg.gatherMs + 120)]);

// 4) CastFire webm large at the target + screenshake

const vid = await loadVideo(A.cast);

const tex = PIXI.Texture.from(vid);

const nativeW = tex.width || tex.orig?.width || 600;

const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

spr.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5); spr.x = pt.x; spr.y = pt.y; spr.zIndex = 8000;

spr.scale.set(hPx(cfg.castSize) / nativeW);

spr.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

stage.addChild(spr); spawned.push(spr);

try { vid.currentTime = 0; await vid.play(); } catch (_) {}

screenShake(cfg.shakeMs, cfg.shakePx);

playSfx(cfg.sfxExplosion, cfg.sfxExplosionVol); // ending explosion

await waitMs(cfg.doneAtMs);

fireDone({ ok: true });

await new Promise((res) => { let done=false; const go=()=>{if(done)return;done=true;res();}; vid.addEventListener("ended",go,{once:true}); setTimeout(go, cfg.castMaxMs); });

await tween((p) => { spr.alpha = 1 - p; }, cfg.fadeMs, easeOutCubic);
